title: Present Perfect: Ever and Never
completion_message: ¡Genial! Ahora puedes preguntar sobre experiencias y hablar de cosas que nunca has hecho usando Ever y Never.

parts.visual: Usamos EVER (alguna vez) en preguntas para saber si alguien ha tenido una experiencia en su vida. Va ANTES del participio. Have you EVER worked in sales? (¿Alguna vez has trabajado en ventas?).
parts.audio: We use EVER in questions to ask if someone has had an experience in their life. It goes BEFORE the past participle. Example: Have you EVER worked in sales?

parts.visual: Usamos NEVER (nunca) en oraciones afirmativas para indicar cero experiencia. I have NEVER met the CEO (Nunca he conocido al CEO). No uses 'not' con never: I haven't never met... (Incorrecto).
parts.audio: We use NEVER in affirmative sentences to indicate zero experience. Example: I have NEVER met the CEO. Do not use 'not' with never.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra correcta: ever, never o la forma verbal correcta.

questions.question: Have you ____ been to London? (¿Alguna vez...?).
questions.explanation: En preguntas sobre experiencias en la vida usamos 'ever'.

questions.question: I have ____ worked in Marketing. This is my first time. (Nunca).
questions.explanation: Para expresar que nunca lo has hecho: have never worked.

questions.question: Has she ____ managed a team? (¿Alguna vez ella...?).
We have ____ lost a client. (Nunca).
questions.explanation: Afirmativa con sentido negativo: We have never lost.

questions.question: Have they ____ complained about the price? (¿Alguna vez...?).
I have never ____ this software before. (Usado).
questions.explanation: Después de have/has + never, el verbo va en participio: used.

questions.question: He has never ____ a presentation in English. (Dado/Hecho).
Have you ____ had a problem with this machine? (¿Alguna vez...?).
questions.explanation: Pregunta sobre experiencia: Have you ever had...?

questions.question: She ____ never spoken to the client. (Ha).
____ you ever traveled for business? (¿Has...?).
questions.explanation: Pregunta con you: Have you ever...

questions.question: Has he ever ____ to our office? (Estado/Ido).
I have never ____ such a big mistake. (Hecho).
Have we ever ____ them a discount? (Ofrecido).
You have ____ been late. Thank you. (Nunca).
Have you ever ____ an international team? (Liderado - lead).
I have ____ written a report like this. (Nunca).
Has the printer ever ____ before? (Fallado - fail).
Have you ____ been to London? (¿Alguna vez?)
Has she ____ managed a team? (¿Alguna vez?)
Have you ____ met the CEO? (¿Alguna vez?)
Have you ____ had a problem? (¿Alguna vez?)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Have you ever been to London?
options: Have you ever been to London?
Have you never been to London?
Has she ever been to London?
Have they ever been to London?
questions.correct_answer: Have you ever been to London?
